name: Fairy Ring
notes: Down the Rabbit-Hole's arrival site. Technically this is a long-range reconstructive teleporter, but do not reveal reclamation/reconstruction mechanics during these Missions. A hoverbike patrol searches here after Méabh appears. Coinín's Hollow Tree stands at the glade's edge; its physical service tunnel emerges through the Hidden hatch near the far side of the clearing.
atmosphere: Still grass, damp leaves, and an eerie sound with no visible musician. The glade feels exposed even before patrol lights move between the trees.
description: A mushroom-ringed clearing beyond Trí Mhuilinn where the ground can wake into a circular skin of moving blue and white light. When closed it is easy to mistake for an odd patch of woodland; when active, nothing about it looks natural.
